name: Start and complete a focus session
description: Verifies a focus session can be started and its active state is shown.
steps: Verify the active countdown and lock status are visible
expected: The active session countdown is visible and the session is marked active.

name: Edit the distraction blocklist
covers: remove app entries from the blocklist
website rule creation, deletion, and validation
description: Verifies blocklist controls update visible selections and website rules validate input.
steps: Toggle one app rule off and on
Remove an app entry and verify it disappears
Delete a website rule and verify it disappears
expected: App selection changes visibly, app and website rules can be removed when no focus session is active, a valid domain is added, and an empty domain is rejected with a validation message.

name: Save a weekly schedule
description: Verifies a weekday schedule can be configured and saved.
steps: Set a start and end time and choose weekdays
expected: The enabled schedule and selected weekdays remain displayed, and the live schedule check shows whether the current local time is inside the selected window or waiting for it.

name: Use Gridlock on a mobile viewport and manage the signed-in account
description: Verifies mobile navigation and account controls remain usable and platform limitations are disclosed.
steps: Open the app on a mobile viewport
Sign in with an existing test account if needed
Click the signed-in profile once and verify the email and Sign out action appear without logging out
Click Sign out and verify the guest account prompt returns
expected: Navigation remains usable, signed-in account details remain visible when account options are opened, sign-out occurs only after selecting Sign out, and permission guidance clearly states this web app cannot enforce Android-wide blocking.

name: Export the blocker configuration
covers: export website and app rules for local enforcement
configuration handoff to Chrome extension and Windows companion
dashboard timer start and stop messages to configured Chrome extension
description: Verifies the Blocklist page exposes an export action for transferring rules to the local enforcement components.
steps: Verify a JSON configuration download is initiated
Open Settings and paste the installed extension ID into Chrome website blocking settings
Start a focus session and verify the dashboard attempts to send start/end signals to the extension
expected: A vexgridlock-blocking-config.json file is downloaded containing the current blocklist and schedule settings, and the configured extension ID is stored for timer integration.
